description: Search the public Ready4Bots index. Free text matches name, industry, tags, product keywords, category, description, and domain, including synonyms such as shoes/sneakers, coffee/espresso, and hotel/lodging. Results are ranked by that relevance, then by published R-level. Filter by category (E-commerce, SaaS, or an industry id such as fashion-shoes), country, exact level (R0–R3 from a published test, R4 only for the certified seal), minimum level, action (search, book, or order), audience (customer, seller, or dev), and certified. The response includes indexSize ("more than 30,000") and indexSource. totalIndexed is omitted. total is the number of matches for this request. limit and offset page those matches. Each result includes level, status, certified, industry, channel, actions, audience, sourceUrl, and ready4botsUrl. A level is present only when a test recorded one. Unverified listings are never certified. The tool waits for the live providers table. indexSource is postgres when that read finishes, including when it returns no public row. indexSource is snapshot, with fallbackReason, only when the database cannot be reached. get_business reads the same catalog.

action.description: Published action: search (product search with prices), book (reservation), or order (cart and checkout).

audience.description: customer when a customer action is published. seller and dev are not in this index and return no rows.

category.description: Channel or industry id, for example SaaS, E-commerce, or coffee-food-drink.

certified.description: true keeps only the Ready4Bots certified seal. false drops sealed listings.

country.description: Country code stored on the listing, for example DE or US.

level.description: Exact published level. R0–R3 are test levels. R4 is the Verified Agent Purchase umbrella. R4-N and R4-W are the two seals. No business has R4 yet.

min_level.description: Keep listings whose published level is at least this. Unscored listings are omitted.

query.description: Free text matched against name, industry, tags, product keywords, category, description, country, id, and domain. shoes matches sneakers, coffee matches espresso, hotel matches lodging.

name: search_businesses

indexSize.description: The only public index size. totalIndexed is omitted.

total.description: Matches for this request. Not a catalog total.

title: Search businesses
